key_topics: Normalized age to frame index computation
Float SubUV index (not integer) for blending
Pixel shader texture sampling and blending
Performance characteristics (5-10% overhead vs plain sprites)
Common pitfalls and how to avoid them

critical_details: SubUVIndex MUST be float (not uint32) — fractional part enables blending
Always normalize age to [0,1] before computing frame index
Sprite texture MUST have alpha channel (BC4 or RGBA8 format)
Double-sample frames only when blending enabled (optional optimization)
notes: All code is copy-paste ready and production-quality
